title: SAM.gov Scraper – Federal Contracts, Bids, Wage Determinations
description: Scrape live US federal contracting opportunities from SAM.gov — presolicitations, solicitations, sources sought and awards — plus Davis-Bacon, Service Contract Act and CBA wage determinations, with no API key and no login. NAICS, set-aside, notice type and state filters, contacts, watch mode.
seoTitle: SAM.gov Scraper — Federal Bids & Wage Determinations API
seoDescription: Scrape SAM.gov federal contract opportunities and Davis-Bacon / SCA / CBA wage determinations — no API key needed. State, NAICS and set-aside filters. No start fee.

result.eventDescription: One normalized SAM.gov record returned to the dataset (a contract opportunity, or a wage determination in the wage-determination data types).
